ctx.x: Did you ever do any teaching or help any pupils?

Well, yes, now in Louisville I did. I, uh, used to teach, uh, help the, help the band, uh, Miss, uh, was a lady. She was sort of a welfare worker and she had a, uh, little band. Got a band brass band together for kids. Uh-huh. And, uh, uh, his, uh, fellow, friend of mine, he started a band, Ralph Browne. And he left, uh, left Louisville. And so she came after me to come up and rehearse and help them. Yeah. And so I went up there and, uh, uh, worked with them for, for a good while and rehearsed them. And I saw…

I was going to, uh, when you were taught, did you use a certain method, like a particular book that you liked better than others, or any? Or, well, now, uh, or you mean instruction books? Yes, when you teach them kids, I mean, start them on spagels and all.
